title: Microsoft Purview DLP: set policy tips and email notifications separately for SharePoint and OneDrive rules (Worldwide)
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing and documented rule controls are supported. However, the page assures readers that no action is needed and that users notice changes only after an administrator changes a rule, although Microsoft has not stated what happens to existing rules. That assurance must be qualified rather than presented as a known rollout default.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches the documented rule policy-tip setting.
claims.quote: On the Define policy settings page, the Create or customize advanced DLP rules option should already be selected. Select Next. ... Set the User Notifications toggle to On. ... Select Notify users in Office 365 services with a policy tip
claims.fix: Expand both copies of the path to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories: Custom > Regulations: Custom > Choose where to apply the policy: SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts > Define policy settings > Customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > User Notifications: On > Notify users in Office 365 services with a policy tip'. Keep the note that this documents the policy-tip setting, not all four portal combinations.

claims.fix: Expand both copies of the path to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories: Custom > Regulations: Custom > Choose where to apply the policy: SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts > Define policy settings > Customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > User overrides > Allow override from M365 services'. Retain the note that overrides require the policy-tip setting.
